title: `Compile Error` when saving script with new `class_name` but the script runs fine
body:
### Tested versions

Reproduced in `4.8.dev`[944a3c6], `4.7.stable`.

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1088) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12700H (20 threads) - 15.69 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When the `class_name` is changed to `test` and a new `print(test)` is added before saving the script, this error appears when saving the script:
`ERROR: res://main.gd:6 - Compile Error: Identifier not found: test`

However, if the script is saved right after changing the `class_name` (before adding the `print(test)`), the error does not appear.

When running the main scene, the script prints correctly without errors in both cases.

Video:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f2725199-9635-4b68-854e-b4eb6cf4beff

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a script `main.gd` and attach it to the main scene `main.tscn`.
2. Type the following, and then save the script.
```gdscript
class_name abc # change this to `class_name test` in step 3
extends Node

func _ready() -> void:
	print() # change this to `print(test)` in step 3
```
3. Apply the changes, and then save the script.
4. Notice the error.
5. Run the scene. The script prints correctly.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
